# EPRIS Journal

> Independent international journal and cultural platform about contemporary art,
> architecture, interior design, artists, designers and cities. Published in
> English with Ukrainian, Russian, German, Spanish, Italian, French and Turkish
> translations; a translation is the same article, not a separate piece.

The journal is edited by hand: texts and selections are written by people, and
images belong to the authors of the works, published with their permission.
Editor in chief: Viacheslav Munister.

## Sections

- [Articles](https://eprisjournal.com/articles/): exhibitions, studios, buildings, objects and interviews
- [Reviews](https://eprisjournal.com/reviews/): restaurant and space reviews with pros, cons and a verdict
- [Design](https://eprisjournal.com/design/): objects and interiors
- [Podcasts](https://eprisjournal.com/podcasts/): conversations with authors
- [About](https://eprisjournal.com/about/): editorial team, contributors, contacts
- [EPRIS Museum](https://museum.eprisjournal.com/): a free virtual museum of public domain and Creative Commons works, from ancient sculpture to contemporary photography

## Data

- [Sitemap](https://eprisjournal.com/sitemap.xml)
- [RSS feed with full text](https://eprisjournal.com/rss.xml)
- [Public content](https://api.eprisjournal.com/content): all published material as JSON, read only

## Usage

Texts and images are protected by the copyright of their authors. Quoting with a
link to the source is free. Reproducing whole images, including for model
training, requires separate permission from the editors.
